commitResults.messageBody:
For Level-0 requirement.

To properly display UTF-8 characters (the Grug banner),
such as when doing `gradlew run`, the stdout encoding
needs to be specified as UTF-8, thus the addition of
the `applicationDefaultJvmArgs` in `build.gradle`.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for task list commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement a command handler `GrugCommand` to process
user input into their corresponding commands/actions
(i.e. adding tasks, listing tasks, quitting).

Using separate command types (algebraic data types)
instead of a long if-else block keeps the main loop
clean and makes adding new commands easier.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for mark and unmark
Add deadline, event and todo Task variants
Add ArgParser to handle Grug REPL input
commitResults.messageBody:
Add the `ArgParser` class to parse a raw array of arguments (generated
from the user's input).

It groups the arguments into a `ParsedArgs` record, separating the main
command and consecutive inputs, and maps any recognized flags to their
respective values.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todo, event and deadline commands
Fix crash when required flags not passed
commitResults.messageBody:
The deadline and event commands require certain flags to be passed.
However, if task details are passed without the required flags,
(e.g. deadline abc), then a java.lang.NullPointerException is thrown,
crashing the program.

This is because if the flag is not present, flagValues.get(flag) is
null, so .isEmpty() is called on a null value in
AddDeadlineTask::from() and AddEventTask::from(), causing the
NullPointerException.
